name: Thistledown
description: A wandering tuft of thistle fluff that treats every breeze like an invitation. It naps midair, tangles politely in hair, and keeps a careful list of every wish anyone has ever whispered past it. Nobody has seen one land on purpose — landings are for goodbyes, and Thistledown hates goodbyes.
babyDescription: A single seed with a parachute three sizes too big.
teenDescription: Catches drafts on purpose and apologizes to nobody.
adultDescription: A crowned drifter that steers by wishing.

history.change: dex-edit: baseColor #D7CCE8 -> #B9B0C2, clearing prismite at 5.2 and driftjelly at 6.9. W64-ROSTER wants dE00 >= 10 between any two species and only ever measured the fourteen COMPILED ones, so no pack species had been checked against anything since the registry began (B343). Measured across the whole 32-species roster; this is the smallest move that clears 11 against all 31 others. Four pack species were moved rather than eight, because every colliding pair has a pack species in it and the compiled roster needs no change at all.
